Name: Locked Maps
Author: eduanttunes
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4][b][/b][/size][/color][/center][center][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]﻿Now you can explore all locked cutscene maps![/b][/size][/color]

[u]Press F1 and choose one of the following maps:[/u]

[b]﻿Darkroom[/b]
[size=1](Haley's 10 heart event, Darkroom)[/size]

[b]ElliottSea[/b]
[size=1](Elliott's 10 heart event, Ocean)[/size]

[b]Dreamscape[/b]
[size=1](Emily's 2 heart event, Dreamscape)[/size]

[b]MarnieBarn[/b]
[size=1](Shane's 8 heart event, Coop beyond the locked kitchen door)[/size]

[b]SceneMaru[/b]
[size=1](Maru's 6 heart event, night scene looking through her telescope)[/size]

[b]SebbyMo[/b]
[size=1](Sebastian's 10 heart event, Mountain)[/size]

[b]SebbyRide[/b]
[size=1](Sebastian's 10 heart event, before the Mountain night scene)[/size]

[b]Stadium[/b]
[size=1](Shane's 10 heart event, Stadium)[/size]

[b]Submarine[/b]
[size=1](Night Market Submarine)

[/size]How to exit the maps? Use CJB Cheats Menu or search for warps at the bottom of the maps (some maps might require noclip mode).

--

Note: this is an experimental mod I made only for a video, not for permanent use. It might not be maintained anymore in a near future.[/center]
